spec-video: Turns a written spec, ADR, or architecture note into a Remotion product-walkthrough film. Reads the brief, extracts a Monday-morning path (not boxes and arrows), scaffolds a nested Remotion project by hand, still-checks key frames, then renders 1920×1080. Routes to video-editing, FFmpeg, and fal.ai only for missing footage or assets. Use when the user wants a video of a spec, a Remotion demo, or a spec-video.
